page.overview:
Who is Adda?

Adda, known in English as Adam, is believed in Christianity to be the first human created by God and the ancestor of all mankind to come.

According to Welsh religious theology book Cyfaddasrwydd y Drefn o Gadwedigaeth trwy Ffydd, Adda's condemned humanity under divine law, making salvation necessary. Without God's intervention, all of his descendants would face eternal punishment. However, forgiveness was granted selectively through , as determined by God's will.
